ui.occurrence.summary.Storage: Most likely {disk} stopped answering for a moment: Windows had to reset its connection, and meanwhile nothing on the PC could move.
ui.occurrence.summary.DiskIo: Disk {disk} was so busy it could not keep up with requests, and the PC waited on it.
ui.occurrence.summary.DiskIo.hdd: A hard disk (HDD) slows down far more than an SSD when many requests arrive at once.
ui.occurrence.summary.DiskIo.who: The program reading and writing the most data was probably {app}, though that count also includes data that never reaches the disk.
ui.occurrence.summary.Memory: The PC's memory was almost full, so Windows had to use the disk in its place, and that slows everything down.
ui.occurrence.summary.Memory.who: The program holding the most memory was {app}.
ui.occurrence.summary.Cpu: The processor was at its limit: every core busy at once, with nothing left over to respond.
ui.occurrence.summary.Driver: A driver held one processor core for too long, and the rest of the PC waited for it.
ui.occurrence.summary.GpuDriver: The graphics driver stopped responding and Windows restarted it. That usually freezes the picture without closing what was open.
ui.occurrence.summary.Throttling: The processor was being held below its normal speed, for lack of power or because of heat.
ui.occurrence.summary.App: The PC itself did not freeze: only {app} stopped responding. When a single app hangs, the problem is usually in the app itself.
ui.occurrence.summary.Unclear: Nothing on the PC was overloaded at the time, so no cause can be named with confidence.
ui.occurrence.note.Driver: A deep capture can name the driver: run it while the hitch is happening.
ui.occurrence.note.default: A deep capture can pin down the cause: run it while the problem is happening.

ui.occurrence.todo.title: What to do
ui.occurrence.todo.none: Nothing to try for this cause yet. If it happens again, open Now to see what is weighing on the PC.
ui.occurrence.step.UpdateStorageDriver: Look for an update to the disk controller driver (SATA or NVMe) on the website of your PC or motherboard maker.
ui.occurrence.step.CheckDiskCable: On a desktop PC, swap the disk's cable or the port it uses on the motherboard.
ui.occurrence.step.RunDiskTest: Check the disk's health with its maker's tool.
ui.occurrence.step.FindDiskHeavyApp: If it happens again, open Now to see who is using the disk, and pause what can wait.
ui.occurrence.step.CloseMemoryHeavyApp: Close the programs and tabs you are not using, to free memory.
ui.occurrence.step.CheckCooling: Check that the air vents are clear and the fan spins; clean out the dust.
ui.occurrence.step.CheckPowerPlan: On a laptop, plug it in and pick the best performance power mode.
ui.occurrence.step.UpdateGpuDriver: Update the graphics driver from its maker's website or app.
ui.occurrence.step.EnableSensitiveMode: If it freezes again, turn on sensitive mode from the tray: for 30 minutes Vestigium watches more closely.
ui.occurrence.step.ReportToAppVendor: If it happens again, update or reinstall {app}; if it keeps happening, tell its makers.
